system.traits: Deadly, Exotic, Finesse, Keen, Versatile P
system.description:
These short, slender blades, measuring between 1 to 2 feet in length, serve various purposes. They are primarily utilized as backup weapons in combat, to perform the solemn act of decapitating defeated adversaries, or to carry out seppuku, a ritual form of suicide upheld as a matter of honour.

Traits as printed: Deadly, Finesse, Keen, Versatile P.

Proficiency: the Ghostwalker and the Oathblade treat it as a martial weapon (registered with their classes).
